newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied Materials raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied Materials raised.

text.p: -- Robertson Stephens & Co said its analyst Sue Billat raised her fiscal 1997 and fiscal 1998 estimates for semiconductor equipment maker Applied Materials Inc following that company's second quarter earnings report late Tuesday.
-- In a statement Billat said she raised her 1997 earnings forecast to $2.48 a share from $2.20 and 1998 to $3.87 from $3.25.

-- Billat said she believes the company "has turned the corner" on chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) equipment used for making microchips. She said she believes Applied Materials has solved earlier design issues and is seeing "strategically significant repeat orders."
